contracts.world: JSON {isEnableInertia, collisions:[native ordered collision records], map:{tileFlags}, layerChecks, cameraAreaRaw:{x,width}}. Each collision supplies explicit IDs, entityId, raw current/previous positions, current/previous local GetRect bounds, flags, layer, pushBackTarget, collisionType0, contacts and mapNormals. No supportId-to-cache conversion. mapNormals/requestMapNormals store raw vectors; contact normals store exact FP pixels. Full chunk additionally needs scale/preScale/expectedScale, base rectangle/pivot, actorExists and expected position.

contracts.callbacks: refreshContacts requires onContact when a callback would occur. Equal-X inertia contacts require an explicit native tie-order adapter. Callback functions are caller-local and never serialized. Public operations clone input state.
